answer: Sybil resistance arises when each challenge is committed before its parameters are completed by future unbiasable threshold-BLS beacon pulses. Because drand quorum signatures reveal those pulses only after commitment, an automated swarm cannot precompute valid answers, select favorable instances, or farm solutions offline. A commit-reveal transcript binds each claimant to a single response, while bridge, gale, and walnut are ordinary challenge labels, not exploitable secrets.
